blocks.text: Origin / creation. The last complete witnesses remained after other stewards withdrew to verify stable awakenings, automatic maintenance, archive seals, and Gate dormancy.
Identity / human status. Artificial DBA individuals or a small order. Names and exact number are not established.
Importance. They confirmed that small life could continue without direct ancient command and recorded the final transition.
Decline or loss. Sources disagree whether they died, dissolved, entered irreversible dormancy, departed beyond maintained worlds, or participated in Reduction.

Final status / surviving function. Unknown and disputed. Their absence is functional: Era Three cannot appeal to an ancient authority for final answers. Any surviving witness would remain distinct from every cyber-pet.
